description: React component for the 'Join/Leave Messages' section in user advanced settings, allowing toggling of join/leave message visibility.

classes.name: JoinLeaveSection
classes.description: React component managing the join/leave message toggle in user settings.

methods.name: focusEditButton
methods.description: Sets focus to the edit button.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles focus when component updates based on active/inactive state.

methods.name: handleOnChange
methods.description: Handles change in radio button selection for join/leave messages.

methods.name: handleUpdateSection
methods.description: Updates the section state and calls parent handler.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Saves preferences for join/leave messages and updates section.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the expanded or minimized settings item based on active state.
